_meta.source: K-1 mirror adversarial test lines (9 invariants)
_meta.description: Behavioral assertions that require host+SDK loopback execution (P-2). Schema runner counts and skips these — no silent caps.

cases.invariant: Plugins cannot address threads by raw threadId — only host-signed ThreadHandle accepted
system audience rejected at both draft schema level (structurally impossible) AND host runtime level (double gate)
MessageHandle from instance A must be rejected when used by instance B — handles are instance-scoped
Plugin cannot declare origin other than self (D-4: thread_handle only self, connector_binding only matching binding, host undeclarable)
appendElements with stale baseRevision must result in CONFLICT error and zero applied changes
Subscription that falls behind event window enters stale state; client must call snapshot; resumed subscription picks up from resumeSequence without gap or duplicate
ackToken from subscription A must be rejected when used on subscription B — tokens are subscription-local
replyTo referencing a message in a different thread must be rejected — otherwise replyPreview would leak cross-thread content
Element declaring epistemicStatus higher than its derivedFrom source must be rejected (INV-7: inference cannot be promoted to user_intent)
